docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
echo "=== GET /desktop (authenticated) ==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -o /tmp/desk.html -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/desktop
echo "--- title & vite script tags ---"
grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/desk.html
grep -oE "<script[^>]*src=\"[^\"]*\"[^>]*>" /tmp/desk.html | head
grep -oE "<link[^>]*href=\"[^\"]*\"[^>]*>" /tmp/desk.html | head
' 2>&1
